quirks: Must set model to exactly "google/gemini-2.5-pro" (provider/model slug, not just "gemini-2.5-pro").
OpenAI-compatible chat completions schema; supports standard params (temperature, max_tokens, etc.).
Price varies by token usage; this hello call cost ~$0.0086 USDC on Base.
usage.guide: Call POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/chat/completions over x402 (USDC on Base) with an OpenAI-style JSON body: set model to "google/gemini-2.5-pro" and pass a messages array of {role, content} objects. The response is a synchronous OpenAI-format chat.completion; read the assistant reply from body.choices[0].message.content. Cost is per-token (varies); a short prompt runs well under a cent. No API key or sign-in needed — payment alone authorizes the call.
